Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `frost` (Epic eye), 28 x 12 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Frost. VFX: kept on the body (Epic, Effects.luau): every 12 s it sneezes, a burst of
twenty snowflakes thrown forward off its muzzle that spin as they fall (the flourish Burst at
Mouth), frost breath puffs forward off the muzzle twice a second (the Emitter at Mouth), a cool
blue light on its body, snowflakes drift down off its back (the Emitter at Top) and a fang
glints every 3 s (the Sparkle at Mouth); the two icicle fangs and the tail tip are lit ice; it
breathes 4 percent; in the rig the ruff of quills bristles, the ears flick, the lit tail sways
and the front paws knead, and the sneeze is the flourish: a wind-up squash with the ruff
popped, then a hop and a full turn, ears flared and the tail swished
